steps.decision: QC passes; proceed to design assessment.
Full rank; treatment is estimable separately from batch. Multiple batches require blocked model.
Partial batch fraction: aggregate residual sum of squares removed by adding batch after treatment, divided by treatment-only residual sum of squares. Not a causal variance component.
Batch-adjusted gene-wise OLS with two-sided t tests; exploratory log-expression model, not negative-binomial inference.
